passages.reading: AI 的读法：“天之道，损有馀而补不足”，如张弓之高者抑、下者举。脊柱不支持把它当作展开整体的定律：环路每一环节返还不少于所受时，任何一圈都不闭合差异（`LoopReturn.never_closes_of_no_less`），闭合需要一个返还少于所受的环节（`closing_needs_less`），返还低于所受的返回映射在 d 圈内闭合（`closes_within`），而闭合正差异的环不是无损的（`closing_not_lossless`）。单侧的部分也有：自下的恢复（`Flow.restores`）、过度拿取的降低（`Flow.excess_lowers`）。所以“损有余补不足”是某种调节耦合的性质，而不是天的普遍性质；双向调节的确切定律已证（`Becoming.Regulation`）：平衡下，合取的交换在两侧都以与 m 的距离为界，恰是下一水平落在 m 与当前水平之间（`Flow.withinGap_iff_between`）；有界且两侧都与偏离相反时，距离为正则每步至少降一，距离用尽时水平定于 m（`Flow.regulates`、`Flow.settles`）。两种失败也是确切的：越界的相反交换越过 m（`Flow.crosses_of_above`），其证人在 m 两侧往复而永不到 m（`Overshooting.oscillates`）；只有一侧时，恢复律的前提成立而水平永在 m 之上（`OneSided.above`）。经文把它归于“天之道”，这一归属理论不采纳。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'reducing excess and making up deficiency' is not a law of the whole unfolding on the spine (a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less, and closing is not lossless); it is the property of a regulating coupling. That law is proved (Becoming.Regulation): bounded by the gap on both sides and opposing, the level settles at m within its gap; beyond the bound it crosses m and can alternate without end; one side alone can leave it away for ever.

gap.statement: Flow.regulates: for a flow `L` and web `W` with `L.BalancesOn W [c] (T + k)` for every `k`, and a level `m`, suppose at every step `t ≥ T`: (i) if `m < W.level t c` then `L.given t c < L.taken t c` and `L.taken t c ≤ L.given t c + (W.level t c - m)`; (ii) if `W.level t c < m` then `L.taken t c < L.given t c` and `L.given t c ≤ L.taken t c + (m - W.level t c)`; (iii) if `W.level t c = m` then `L.taken t c = L.given t c`. Then the distance `(W.level t c - m) + (m - W.level t c)` never rises from `T` on and falls by at least one at each step at which it is positive, so `W.level t c = m` for every `t ≥ T + ((W.level T c - m) + (m - W.level T c))`. Exactness: without the bounds in (i)–(ii) some balanced flow has its level above `m` at every even step and below at every odd step from `T` (overcorrection oscillates); without (i) the level can stay above `m` at every step (one-sided restoration, `Flow.restores`, is not regulation).
gap.why_it_matters: It gives 损有馀而补不足, 张弓 (77) and 冲气以为和 (42) a checked form as the property of a coupling that reads the level on both sides with bounded correction, with exactly where it fails (one side only, overcorrection), instead of a law of the whole; it also connects the Widening loop law to levels, and is likely shared with the Ru slice's 中和.
gap.closed: RG (Becoming.Regulation, record two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading), as stated for one condition, with the bound read as no overshoot: the exchange is within the gap to m on both sides exactly where the next level lies between m and the level (Flow.withinGap_iff_between); with it and opposing on both sides the level is m from T plus its gap at T on (Flow.regulates, Flow.settles); (iii) is not needed, since at m the bound itself keeps the level at m (Flow.withinGap_iff_of_at). Both failures are exact: beyond the bound an opposing exchange crosses m and a witness alternates without end (Flow.crosses_of_above, Regulation.Overshooting.oscillates); with one side only the premise of Flow.restores holds and the level stays above m (Regulation.OneSided.above).

passages.corrected: RG proved the two-sided law the reading named as a gap, with both of its failures; names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged

fragments: 人之道则不然
损不足以奉有馀
passages.relational: What rises in one place is given from another within one exchange; the passage names the direction in which the low feeds the high.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“损不足以奉有馀”是本切片最清楚的一种集体吸引子的描述。脊柱给出确切结构：每次上升都是被给予的（`Flow.rise_netGiver`）；在平衡的流中，一族的上升完全由族外给予（`Flow.Balances.rise_paid_from_beyond`）；同一交换中一员上升则另一员下降（`Flow.rise_with_fall`）；当一种目标的承载者留下更多后代时，其份额严格上升（`share_rises`）；持续的全拿者使旁边的其他拿取者无法继续（`Flow.continuing_excludes`）。这些是关于方向与来源的定律，不含评价；把它判为“不然”需要延续条件与比较承诺。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'taking from those who lack to offer to those who have more' matches the laws that every rise is given, a rise is given from beyond, one member rises only as another falls, and a carrier's share rises; the verdict that this is wrong needs the continuation condition and the comparison commitment.

fragments: 夫佳兵者，不祥之器
不得已而用之，恬淡为上
胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人
passages.relational: Force ends formations within the same relation the user belongs to; even the prevailing course carries the loss.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：本条是有条件的对应。在延续条件之下（`Unrestricted`：凡物之延续有意义），一个部分使某个有意义的延续丧失，恰在没有它时水平容许该形成而有它时超出余裕（`Flow.Balances.loses_iff_beyond_margin`）；以保留比较并不许可任何终结（`Web.Retains.not_added`）；两条各有对方所无的混合路径互不保留，排序需要一个度量（`Transfer.unordered`）——这对应“不得已而用之”：只有在没有一条路径保留另一条的一切时，才需要比较承诺。“胜而不美”对应：支持恢复后，已失去的仍然失去（`MatchedCourses.recovery_retains_loss` 的见证）。郭店丙本存“君子居则贵左，○（用）兵则贵右”，“不祥之器”处残缺。武（止戈）属于文字切片。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: under the continuation condition, ending formations loses continuations with significance, retaining-comparison licenses no ending, and mixed courses stay unordered until a measure is supplied, which is the structure of 'using it only when there is no alternative'; 'victory is not beautiful' matches that recovered support does not restore what was lost.

variants.note: 郭店丙本，“兵者不祥之器”处残缺。

passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 上善若水
水善利万物而不争
passages.relational: Benefiting all things without taking all is a relation among takers of one condition: joint taking within what is given versus one taker taking all.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：把“利万物而不争”读作在共同条件上的给予与拿取关系。脊柱：在所给之内共同拿取，水平从不低于起点（`Flow.level_kept`），共同历程使每个仅依赖该条件的形成保持被支持（`Flow.supported_of_within`）；而在一个全拿者旁边，任何其他拿取者都使共同拿取超过所给（`Flow.excess_of_takesAll`），持续的全拿者使旁边无他者能继续（`Flow.continuing_excludes`），能在他者旁持续的就不是全拿（`Flow.alongside_not_all`）。v9.1 KR2202 提醒“不争否定争夺而不否定为”。异文改变读法：帛书甲作“善利萬物而有靜”，帛书乙作“善利萬物而有爭”，该句中没有“不争”（章末“夫唯不爭”仍在）。郭店无此章。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: benefiting all things without contending matches joint taking within what is given, which keeps the level and every dependent supported, against a full taker, which excludes every other taker; in the 帛书 texts the clause reads 'and is still' or 'and contends', so 'without contending' is not in that clause.

fragments: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争
passages.relational: Contending is a relation of seekers to one another's standing; not entering it removes the relation.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：把“争”读作寻求“高于其余一切”的目标。脊柱：在一个状态上，“高于其余一切”至多被一个寻求者满足（`aboveAll_unique`）；在任何律下，两个都寻求“高于其余一切”的寻求者不能一起静止（`Law.aboveAll_never_rests`）；“比现在更多”永不静止（`Law.more_never_rests`），而可在静止处满足的目标才能安定（`Law.rests_iff`）。所以不以“高于其余”为目标者不在这个不能静止的结构之中，“莫能与之争”在这一意义上成立：争的关系需要双方都持这一目标。经文的“莫能与之争”若读作“因此无人能胜过他”，则是一个获胜的主张，脊柱不支持。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: read as seeking to stand above all others, contending is a target met by at most one seeker that two seekers can never meet together at rest; a formation that does not hold this target is outside that restless structure, whereas reading the line as a way to prevail is not supported.

fragments: 其安易持，其未兆易谋
为之于未有
合抱之木，生于毫末
passages.relational: Acting before signs appear is a relation of a course to the junctures it passes before amounts show anything.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：其安易持、未兆易谋、为之于未有。脊柱：凡返回的配置之丧失都经过一个关节点（`Branching.loss_passes_juncture`），关节点是保持与丧失都有一步之处（`juncture_iff`），“保持”是保持该配置的最大子过程（`keeping_greatest`）——这就是“为之于未有”的位置。脊柱同时给出界限：在每个过程中找到每次丧失的关节点，等于有限全知原则（`lpo_of_junctures_found`），即找到关节点就是判定该配置能否再得；而环形成之前，携带量不显示它（`Closing.Onset.amount_before`），增长至多为多项式（`carried_le_polynomial_before`），所以“未兆”恰是量上看不出、只能从耦合读出之处。“合抱之木，生于毫末”与环形成之后的倍增相合。经文假定未兆时易谋；脊柱说易在可干预，难在可发现。郭店作“亡又（有）也。○（治）之于其未乱”。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: every loss passes a juncture where keeping and losing both have a step, which is the place to act 'before it exists'; but finding the juncture of every loss is the limited principle of omniscience, and before a loop forms the amounts do not show it, so what is easy to change is hard to find except through the couplings.

variants.fragment: 亡又（有）也。○（治）之于其未乱

fragments: 小国寡民
使民重死而不远徙
民至老死，不相往来
passages.relational: The ideal cuts couplings between communities; each closure reaches only itself.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：本章的理想是小而封闭、彼此不相往来的共同体。在其“足”的部分（甘其食、安其居）它与知足条目相合；在“不相往来”的部分它与理论分歧。脊柱：未连接的形成只达及自身（`Cuts.within_of_unlinked`）；在合用耦合闭包之外，什么都不被选择（`Flow.unselected_beyond_pool`）；一个持续交换的有限整体会遗忘（`World.forgets_of_bounded`），其余部分不给净供给时有界整体返回并遗忘（`Flow.whole_recurs_of_rest_idle`），无尽的新颖要求在每个持有它的有限族之外都有交换（`Flow.new_beyond_every`）。所以这一理想保障的是返回与静止，不是生生的继续生成；在延续条件与 C 之下，收窄所失的有意义延续使它不能被判为更好。异文要紧：帛书乙作“使民重死而遠徙”，帛书甲作“使民重死而遠送”，皆无“不”（TV-LAO-012），封闭的读法因而只属于传世本这一句。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: the self-enclosed community diverges from the theory: an unlinked formation reaches only itself, a bounded whole that keeps exchanging returns and forgets, and endless novelty needs exchange beyond every finite family; the 'not moving far' clause lacks its negation in both 帛书 texts.

fragments: 知不知上，不知知病
夫唯病病，是以不病
passages.relational: Knowing is a relation of a reading to what it can and cannot settle; marking the unsettled as unsettled is itself a reading.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：把“知不知”读作保留未定值，把“不知知”读作把未定强作已定。脊柱有精确的两面：说谎者句的修正在二值下永不静止，在三值下静止于未定（`Undecided.liar_both_sides`）；凡二值修正无不动点之处，修正的运行只在留下未定之句时静止（`Undecided.rest_undecided`）；移动每个值的修正永不静止（`Diagonal.revision_never_rests`）；内部的成员说不出缺口（`Diagonal.gap_unsaid`）。“病病”——把病标为病——对应：在信息上单调的修正从未定值出发，第一步即静止（`Undecided.monotone_run_rests`）。经文只说上与病，没有说何处必须未定；脊柱说在没有不动点之处。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'knowing that one does not know' matches keeping the undecided value, with which revision rests where two-valued revision never rests, and 'taking not-knowing for knowing' matches forcing two values onto a claim without a fixed point.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏
孰知其极？其无正
正复为奇
passages.relational: Misfortune and fortune each lean on and hide the other; the pair is one alternating course.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：祸福相倚伏，正复为奇，其无正。脊柱：二值否定每两步返回（`Diagonal.negation_returns`），恰有两个状态，每个都转入另一个（`Negation.two_states`、`each_through_other`）；移动每个值的映射之修正永不静止（`Diagonal.revision_never_rests`）——这是“其无正”（没有一个定的终点）的确切形式。范围同样确切：在信息上单调的映射从未定值出发即静止（`Undecided.monotone_run_rests`），有不动点的修正会静止。所以“其无正”恰对移动每个值的修正成立，不是普遍律。经文的“孰知其极”也合于此：在没有不动点处，没有一个可以停下来的极。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: fortune and misfortune turning into each other match the two-state course of negation, and 'there is no fixed correct point' holds exactly for revisions that move every value, which never rest; where a fixed point exists, revision rests.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 将欲歙之，必固张之
国之利器不可以示人
passages.relational: One will acts on another through the other's own course while keeping its means out of the other's coupling; the relation is steered from one side.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：本章有两层。作为自然律读，“将欲弱之，必固强之”与脊柱相合：以递增拿取为生者会终结（`Flow.seeking_ends`），封闭处的“更多”会耗尽（`Flow.more_exhausted`）。但经文的结构是一个意志对另一方的谋划：为使对方收缩而先使其扩张，并且“利器不可以示人”，把手段保持在对方耦合之外。这与理论分歧：理论的明经由合用耦合扩展，合用池分开其成员不全耦合相同者（`Web.separates_all_iff`），差异正是合用所加（`Web.pool_adds`），而在耦合闭包之外者不被选择（`Flow.unselected_beyond_pool`）——隐藏耦合正是使他者在闭包之外。王弼注读作“因物之性，令其自戮，不假刑”，减弱了诈术色彩，但仍是一方使另一方自毁。本章在兵家、法家的接受史中被读作术，属其他切片。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: as a natural law, a rising take ends and an enclosed 'more' is exhausted, which agrees; but the chapter's structure is one will steering another through its own course while keeping its means hidden, which diverges from 明 as widening pooled coupling, since hiding the coupling places others outside the closure.

fragments: 非以明民，将以愚之
passages.relational: One center shapes what the many can know; the knowing of the many is narrowed from one side.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“非以明民，将以愚之”（并见第三章“常使民无知无欲”）是一个中心收窄众人认识的结构。这与理论分歧：池恰分开其成员不全耦合相同者（`Web.separates_all_iff`），差异是合用所加（`Web.pool_adds`），池对其闭包之外的作为不作响应（`Flow.response_alike_pool`），闭包之外者不被选择（`Flow.unselected_beyond_pool`）；收窄众人的耦合就是缩小全体能看见的范围，使到断裂的距离更无从耦合进来（`Web.break_not_bounded`）。须如实记下王弼注的读法：“明谓多见巧诈，蔽其朴也。愚谓无知守真，顺自然也”，即“明”指巧诈而非理论之明；但同章注又说“当务塞兑闭门，令无知无欲”，仍是一方关闭他者的通道。分歧在于结构（一方收窄多方），不在于“明”这个字。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: a center making the many less knowing diverges from 明 as pooled coupling, which separates exactly what not all members couple alike; 王弼 reads 明 here as cunning, but his note still has one side closing others' openings, so the divergence is structural, not verbal.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 圣人无常心，以百姓心为心
passages.relational: The sage's reading is not fixed in itself; it is the pooled reading of the many.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“无常心，以百姓心为心”与理论的明的第三条路线（他者，合用耦合）结构相同：池恰分开其成员不全耦合相同者（`Web.separates_all_iff`），差异是合用在任何单个成员之上所加（`Web.pool_adds`），池经由耦合的响应是精确的（`ExchangeLaw.acts_alike_all_iff`）；界限同样确切：闭包之外者，池也看不见（`Flow.unselected_beyond_pool`）。这一章是第六十五章（愚民）在同一经文内的反向证据：老子的治理层并非只有一个中心收窄众人的结构。经文没有说百姓之心如何汇合，脊柱给出的是合用的条件。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: having no fixed mind and taking the people's minds as one's own matches 明 through pooled coupling, which separates exactly what not all members couple alike and is blind only beyond its closure; it is counter-evidence within the text to the one-center strand of chapter 65.

fragments: 绝圣弃智，民利百倍
passages.relational: Cutting off X restores Y for the people: a relation between what is withdrawn and what others require.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“绝 X，民 Y”的结构在脊柱中有确切条件：撤去一个部分后，凡 f 被支持之处其余水平仍容许 f，恰当该部分在 f 所需的每个条件上拿取不少于给予（`Flow.Balances.admits_of_net_draw`）；一个净给予者从不使被容许者失去支持（`supported_of_net_give`）；部分造成的差别由它拿取与给予的累计给出（`Flow.Balances.withheld`）。所以“绝而民利”恰在所绝者净汲取民之所需时成立；所绝者若是净给予者，绝之则损。异文改变了被绝之物：郭店作“○（绝）智（知）弃卞（辩）”与“○（绝）○（伪）弃○，民复（復）季（孝）子（慈）”，没有“绝圣”“绝仁弃义”（TV-LAO-003）。在郭店本中，本章不针对仁义；“民复孝慈”说的是撤去伪饰后关系恢复。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'cut off X and the people gain' holds exactly where X net-draws on what the people require, since withdrawing a net drawer never closes admission and withdrawing a net giver can; the 郭店 text cuts off knowing, disputation and artifice rather than sageliness, humaneness and rightness.

fragments: 不出户，知天下
其出弥远，其知弥少
passages.relational: Knowing the world without going out is a relation of one's lumping to how the world goes; going far changes which configurations one's lumping must cover.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“不出户，知天下”在脊柱中有确切范围：在有限世界中，经由一个映射可学到的，恰是同一未来者特征终归一致的那些（`Learnable.learnable_iff`；静止律下恰是在映射合并之间相同者，`still_learnable_iff_lumped`）；有界时归纳即演绎（`Identification.bounded_induction`）。“其出弥远，其知弥少”有一个确切的意义：把范围扩展到经由映射相同而特征在任意晚处不同的配置，就没有外推能同时静止于两者（`Learnable.not_predicts_on_both`）——走得更远，若仍用原来的合并，可学者变少。但在闭包之外什么都不被选择（`Flow.unselected_beyond_pool`）：不出户只知道户内耦合所及的天下。经文的普遍形式被限定为“世界在你的合并上走得一样之处”。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: knowing the world without going out holds exactly where the world is bounded and its features go alike across one's lumping; going farther with the same lumping can make features unlearnable, and nothing beyond one's coupling closure is selected at all.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged; record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗
passages.relational: Heaven and earth stand in no favoring relation to any thing; things are taken up and let go in the one course.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“天地不仁”与理论的出发点相合：展开整体不被假定为善，理论不断言伦理公理；每个世界只是交换律的一个运行（`World.unity`），其中生成与退化都发生。“以万物为刍狗”作为对展开的描述也相合：事物在其中被用过即弃。但这不是关于意义的陈述。在延续条件之下（`Unrestricted`），凡物之延续都有意义，并且没有立场有特权（`Web.retains_agree`），以保留作比较并不许可任何终结（`Web.Retains.not_added`），混合部分无序（`Transfer.unordered`）。所以“不仁”在“展开无偏爱、无伦理谓词”的意义上成立；若把第五章下句“圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗”读作实践立场，它与理论的条件伦理分歧。这是旧研究列为反压力的段落；它限定而不否定理论。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'heaven and earth are not humane' agrees with the theory's refusal to assume the unfolding good and with the absence of any ethical axiom; as a stance toward people it diverges from the conditional ethics, under which every continuation has significance and no standpoint is privileged.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 和大怨，必有馀怨
passages.relational: Reconciliation acts on a relation that already carries a loss; the loss stays in the relation.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：调和大怨，必有余怨。脊柱：丧失的可能保持丧失，在任何律下（`Law.lost_stays`）；被合并的配置保持合并，以后的步骤不再分开它们（`Law.merged_stays`）；支持恢复之后，已失去的主张仍然失去（`MatchedCourses.recovery_retains_loss` 的见证）；每个确定的律恰吸入不返回者（`Law.drawn_iff_not_returns`）。所以“和”之后有余，在损失已经发生之处是定律；本章接着以“执左契而不责于人”转向事前，与第六十四章“为之于未有”同一方向。经文没有说余怨能否经新的关系化解；脊柱也只说丢失者不返回，不说新形成者不能出现。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'reconciling a great grievance leaves a residue' matches the laws that a lost possibility stays lost and merged configurations stay merged, so recovery after loss retains the loss.

fragments: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼
passages.relational: A one-way ladder from an original fullness, each differentiation read as a loss of what came before.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：本章把道、德、仁、义、礼排成一条单向的丧失之梯：每一层都是前一层失去之后才出现，礼是“忠信之薄而乱之首”。这与理论分歧之处在于“起点完满、分化即丧失”的框架。脊柱中丧失是合并，丧失的保持丧失（`Law.lost_stays`、`Law.merged_stays`）；但分化本身不是丧失：严格细分增加一类（`Refining.grow`），新者由族外给予（`Flow.new_from_rest_or_open`），持续的整体只经由新部分持续（`Web.Whole.needs_new`）。理论中生成与退化不重叠，展开不假定从一个完满起点开始。所以本章作为“名目化的规范是关系变薄的迹象”的观察可以保留，作为普遍的退化史是理论不断言的。帛书乙同有此序列。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: the ladder from the way down to ritual reads every differentiation as loss from an original fullness, which the theory does not assert: loss on the spine is merging, while refinement adds classes and new forms are given from beyond.

variants.fragment: 故失道而后德失德而句仁失仁而句義

passages.locator: 王弼注 第四十章；第三十八章
fragments: 有之所始，以无为本，将欲全有，必反于无也
不能舍无以为体也
passages.relational: Not relational at its root: 无 is the 本 and 体 of all 有, a ground on which every thing depends and which depends on none.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：王弼以“无”为“有”之本、之体，“将欲全有，必反于无”。这是先在根据式的结构，与理论从一个关系性展开开始相分歧，也超出经文（经文第四十章在郭店作并列的“生于有，生于亡”）。脊柱中最接近“万有皆依而无一部分能改变者”的结构是“整体之律而无部分”：一个由水平读出、任何单一条件都不改变的数，只由尾部决定（`ChangedByNoCondition.eq_of_agree_from`），其律对每个条件在每一步都不敏感（`wholeLaw_insensitive`）；但这样一个仍有差别的整体之律存在，恰当一个判定每个布尔序列是否全假的规则存在（`changedByNoCondition_iff_rule`，即以规则形式的 WLPO），核心不假定它。而“有”从“无”生在第一律下只在局部成立：一个关系项从零开始成立需要被他者给予（`Flow.BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff`），有限整体只从其余部分得益（`Flow.whole_rise_from_rest`）。所以“以无为本”在理论中至多是一种需要全知原则的整体读法，不是起点。v9.1 KR2092 记录了裴頠“可损盈欲，不可绝有”的反驳。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 王弼's non-being as the root and substance of all being is a prior ground that diverges from the relational start; the spine's nearest structure, a law of the whole that no part changes, exists exactly where a WLPO rule does, which the core does not assume, and arising from nothing holds only locally, as being given by others.

passages.locator: 王弼注 第五十七章；第三十八章
fragments: 夫以道治国，崇本以息末，以正治国，立辟以攻末
守母以存其子，崇本以举其末
passages.relational: Outcomes (末) are kept by the rule that forms them (本); acting on outcomes alone leaves the rule unchanged.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：王弼对比“崇本以息末”与“立辟以攻末”：攻其末而本不立，末浅而复起。脊柱的确切对应是“持久的改变必须到达规则”：下一配置依赖规则而不依赖状态时，同一规则下的两个配置从下一步起轨道相同，只扰动状态会被重新吸收（`Law.perturbation_reabsorbed`）；两层运行中，两层的步都不读快层配置时，快层扰动在下一步被吸收（`Pace.byRule_reabsorbed`），在第一个读取步之前快层的差异到不了规则（`Pace.rule_alike_until_reading`），从不读取的规则任何快层所遇都到不了（`Pace.rule_unreached`）。理论第七章用 `share_rises` 与此同读“捕获”。限定：王弼的“本”在他处是“无”（见 wb-40-38），这里只取“本 = 生成末的规则”这一结构；把本读作规则是 AI 的读法。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'honor the root to still the branches' versus 'set up prohibitions to attack the branches' matches the law that perturbing the state alone is re-absorbed and a lasting change has to reach the rule; reading 本 as the rule is the AI's reading, since elsewhere 王弼's 本 is 无.

passages.locator: 王弼注 第四十二章
fragments: 已谓之一，岂得无言乎。有言有一，非二如何
从无之有，数尽乎斯，过此以往，非道之流
passages.relational: Naming the one from within adds the naming to what is named: the count grows by the act of saying.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：王弼把一、二、三读作言说的展开：既称之为一，就有了言；有言有一，便是二。这与对角律结构相同：在内部说出所读者，每一步都留下自己的缺口，缺口在它之前的任何一步都没有被说出（`Diagonal.Unfolds.gap_new`），没有两个缺口相同（`gaps_differ`），展开永不闭合也永不返回（`unfolding_open`）。但王弼接着说“数尽乎斯，过此以往，非道之流”：数到三为止。脊柱给出相反的确切结论：补全永不停止。所以王弼的“有言则有二”与脊柱相合，“数尽于三”被脊柱纠正。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 王弼's 'once called one, there is speech, and speech with the one makes two' matches the diagonal law that saying from within adds a new gap at every step, but his 'the count ends at three' is corrected by the same law, under which completion never closes.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 喜怒同根，是非同门，故不可得偏举也
passages.relational: Paired terms share one root; taking one side alone loses the relation that makes it what it is.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：王弼说喜怒同根、是非同门，不可偏举。脊柱：分开（把整体读作各部分之积）不增不减，恰当各部分不相关（`separation_faithful_iff`）；相关的部分分开读就失去关系。关系由耦合形成（`copy_relates`），遗忘一部分则使其不再相关（`forgetting_unrelates`）；二值否定的两个状态各经由对方而得（`Negation.each_through_other`）。所以“不可偏举”恰在两方相关之处成立；对于真正不相关的两方，偏举无损。王弼把此归于“自然不可偏举之明数”，脊柱给出何时为真。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'joy and anger share a root, so one cannot be raised alone' matches the law that separating a whole into its parts loses nothing exactly when the parts are unrelated, so one-sided raising loses the relation wherever the pair is related.

fragments: 天地任自然，无为无造，万物自相治理，故不仁也
passages.relational: Things order one another; no ordering comes from outside their mutual relations.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：王弼把“天地不仁”解释为天地无为无造、万物自相治理。这是本切片注层中最直接的关系性表述，与脊柱结构相同：每个世界是交换律的一个运行，其平衡就是其诸读法的粘合（`World.unity`）；规律从历史读出（`exists_law_iff`）；一方之所为即他方之所受（`Run.rest_driven_by_part`），而历程不确定动作属于谁（`TwoClocks.one_course_two_laws`）。王弼同时说“仁者必造立施化，有恩有为”，“造立施化，则物失其真”，即把关照读作外加的造作。理论不采纳这一推论：延续条件之下的伦理不是外加的施恩，而是关系中延续的意义，见 lao-05。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'things order one another' is the commentary layer's most direct relational statement and matches the spine's one run whose balance is the gluing of its readings, with law read off the history; 王弼's further inference that care is an external imposition is not adopted.

passages.locator: 河上公注 第六章；第十六章
fragments: 人能养神则不死也
言安静者是为复还性命，使不死也
passages.relational: Not relational in its aim: the persistence of one self is secured by inner cultivation, not by passing within relations.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：河上公把谷神读作“养神则不死”，把复命读作“复还性命，使不死”。这是个体不死的养生读法，理论不断言。脊柱：在不被支持之后，有储备的形成在任意晚的步上不再生起，休眠推迟终结而不逃脱它（`Web.Carries.arising_not_recurring`），储备为 k 时至多再活跃 k 次（`Web.Carries.lasts_within`）；持续者是样式而非承载者：样式靠传递持续，传递停止则一个跨度内结束（`ByPassing.ends_within`），由有终部分构成的整体只经由新部分持续（`Web.Whole.needs_new`）。河上公第五十四章注“长生不死，世世以久”若读作世代相续，则与 `Generations.generations` 相合；第六、十六章的个体不死与之分歧。同一注内另有自我修正，见 hs-39-bu-ke-dan-yu。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 河上公's 'nourishing the spirit, one does not die' is an individual deathlessness the theory does not assert: a reserve defers the end and does not escape it, and what lasts is a pattern passed on, which fits his lineage reading in chapter 54 but not the individual reading here.

variants.note: 河上公第五十四章注：读作世代相续时与 Generations 相合。

passages.locator: 河上公注 第三十九章
fragments: 言谷当有盈缩虚实，不可但欲盈满无已时，将恐枯竭不为谷
言万物当随时生死，不可但欲长生无已时，将恐灭亡不为物
passages.relational: A valley is a valley through filling and emptying; things are things through living and dying in time.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：河上公说谷当有盈缩虚实，不可但欲盈满无已时；万物当随时生死，不可但欲长生无已时。脊柱：“比现在更多”永不静止（`Law.more_never_rests`），每步都满足的“更多”需要开放世界（`more_needs_open`），封闭处的“更多”会耗尽（`Flow.more_exhausted`），共同过度不能持续（`Flow.excess_bounded`）；持续的整体需要部分在任意晚的步生起（`Web.Whole.needs_arising`），即有生有死。本条与 hs-06-16-bu-si 在同一注本中互相牵制：第三十九章否定了“但欲长生无已时”，而第六、十六章许诺不死。脊柱的定律与第三十九章相合，与第六、十六章所许诺的不死相分。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 'a valley must fill and empty; wanting it always full dries it up; things must live and die in time; wanting endless life destroys them' matches the laws that more-than-now never rests and a lasting whole needs parts that keep arising, and it checks 河上公's own promises of deathlessness elsewhere.
passages.corrected: review: "the theory supports chapter 39" stated as which laws agree with which chapter

passages.locator: 苏辙《老子解》第十六章注
fragments: 惟復于性而後湛然常存矣
不以復性為明則皆世俗之智雖自謂明非明也
passages.relational: Not relational at its root: a nature (性) prior to all relations, recovered by turning back, persists unchanged.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：苏辙说天地山河皆变坏不常，“惟復于性而後湛然常存”，并以“復性”为明。这是固定本性的结构：一个先于关系、复归即得、恒常不变者。理论不断言它。脊柱中最接近“湛然常存”者是从不读取快层的规则：它在每一步保持（`Pace.rule_kept`），快层所遇都到不了它（`Pace.rule_unreached`）；但这是展开之内的一种读法，且这样的规则丢失它所合并者（`Pace.never_reads_loses`）。持续的整体只经由新部分持续（`Web.Whole.needs_new`）。在明的问题上分歧更直接：苏辙的明是复归本性，理论的明是看见所经由的耦合，而不经由水平耦合进来者，到断裂的距离无从读出（`Web.break_not_bounded`）。苏辙在本章注中引《易》，把学道排成始于穷理、中于尽性、终于复命（LC-L030），他在第十四章注中又引《楞严》“反流全一”（四库提要称其书“主於佛老同源”）；这一融合在本章注中把“复命”改成了复归本性的结构。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 苏辙's 'only by returning to one's nature does one abide in constant clarity' posits a fixed nature prior to relations, which the theory does not assert; the nearest structure, a rule that never reads and so stays, is a reading within the run that loses what it merges, and his 明 as return to nature differs from 明 as seeing the coupling one acts through.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

passages.locator: 苏辙《老子解》第三十三章注；第十章注
fragments: 分别為智蔽盡為明
蔽盡則無分别故能自知
自一而二蔽之所自生
passages.relational: 明 as the end of distinction: self-knowing is reached by removing every split, including the split of knower and known.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：苏辙以分别为智、蔽尽为明，“蔽盡則無分别故能自知”，并说“自一而二，蔽之所自生”。脊柱有一条与此精确对应的定理，但方向相反：一个内部的族说出每个读法，恰当诸值之间没有可区分者（`Diagonal.complete_iff_alike`）。也就是说，完全的自知只在无分别处成立，苏辙的等价是对的；但脊柱由此读出的是：有可区分者的世界中，内部总有说不出的缺口（`Diagonal.gap_unsaid`），合并了可观测量所区分者的读法不能判定它（`Readout.no_judge_of_merged`），而明经由合用耦合增加区分（`Web.pool_adds`）、经由承载规律的合并（`Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped`）。苏辙的明取消分别，理论的明扩大耦合。分歧在于方向，不在于等价本身。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 苏辙's 'when obscuration is exhausted there is no distinction, so one knows oneself' matches the spine's equivalence that a family within says every reading exactly when nothing can be told apart, but the spine reads it the other way: where anything can be told apart, self-knowing from within is incomplete, and 明 widens coupling rather than ending distinction.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

passages.locator: 苏辙《老子解》第五十一章注
fragments: 物則不能自成逺近相取剛柔相交積而為勢
passages.relational: Things cannot complete themselves; near and far take from each other, hard and soft interact, and what accumulates from that is 勢.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：苏辙解“势成之”：物不能自成，远近相取，刚柔相交，积而为势，而后兴亡治乱之变成。脊柱：每次上升都是被给予的（`Flow.rise_netGiver`）；一个部分造成的差别属于共同活动（`Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint`），差别可以只由共同者造成（`Dependence.differenceOnlyTogether_iff`）；携带量由耦合携带并携带自身（`carriedFrom_carried`），环经由闭合形成（`onLoop_succ_iff`），环形成后差异倍增。所以“积而为势”对应携带量在耦合之环上的积累。经文的“势成之”本身只有三字，此结构属苏辙的解，不是经文的。
passages.reading_en: AI reading: 苏辙's 'things cannot complete themselves; near and far take from each other, hard and soft interact, and accumulation becomes momentum' matches the laws that every rise is given, the difference a part makes belongs to the joint activity, and a carried amount grows along loops once they close.

passages.work: 谭嗣同《仁学》（引汉儒训诂）
fragments: 漢儒訓仁為相人偶。人於人不相偶，尚安有世界？
不相人偶，見我切也，不仁矣
passages.relational: 仁 is read as the mutual pairing of persons (相偶); 不仁 is the self cut out of the pairing (見我切). What relates is person to person; the self differentiates only as a pole of the pairing.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：谭嗣同借汉儒“相人偶”把仁读作人与人相偶这一关系本身，并把“不相偶”读作“见我切”——把自己从关系中切出来。脊柱上对应的结构是：把总是一起变化的两部分分开描述，失去的关系会以多出来的组合重新出现（separation_admits_extra）；遗忘一部分就使它与其余不再相关（forgetting_unrelates）；延续中的族群的区域不是一个切口（Flow.region_not_a_cut）。“尚安有世界”是比脊柱更强的断言：脊柱只证明分开描述会丢失关系，并不证明没有相偶就没有世界。层次：这是晚清作者对汉儒训诂的引用，不是经文，也不是郑注原文。
passages.reading_en: Tan reads 仁 through the Han gloss as persons pairing with each other and 不仁 as the self cut out of the pairing; the spine proves the matching structure, that describing jointly varying parts separately loses their relation, but not Tan's stronger claim that without pairing there is no world.

passages.work: 郑玄《礼记注》（中庸“仁者人也”注）
passages.locator: 《禮記·中庸》「仁者，人也」鄭玄注（《禮記正義》卷五十二）
fragments: 人也，讀如相人偶之「人」。以人意相存問之言。
passages.relational: 郑玄 glosses 人 in 仁者人也 as the 人 of 相人偶: two persons attending to and asking after each other. The relation is a pair relation, formed in mutual regard (存問).
passages.reading: AI 的读法：郑注把“仁者人也”的“人”读作“相人偶”之人，即两人以意相存问。这是一个二元（成对）关系的读法。脊柱给出它的范围：有些关系由整体持有而不由任何一对持有（whole_not_in_pairs：三者中任意两者可以任意，三者一起却不可以），而各语境各自一致也可以拼不成一个整体（Specker.no_whole）。所以“相人偶”抓住了成对的关系，但成对关系不穷尽关系的场。层次对照：同一句经文，朱熹《中庸章句》（R09）读作“人，指人身而言。具此生理”，把仁落在一个具有生理的人身上，是先有承载者的读法；郑注是关系的读法。两者不可混为一层。
passages.reading_en: Zheng Xuan reads 仁者人也 as persons in mutual regard, a pair relation; the spine bounds it, since some relations are held by the whole and by no pair, so pairing does not exhaust the field (Zhu Xi's later gloss on the same line, 人身 bearing 生理, is a bearer-first reading on a different layer).
passages.corrected: the note as it stands in 禮記正義 卷五十二 (the mapper gave it from memory, with 人 unquoted); record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 仁者人也，亲亲为大；义者宜也，尊贤为大。
亲亲之杀，尊贤之等，礼所生也。
passages.relational: 仁 is placed in human relating (人也), and then graded: nearness of kin (亲亲之杀) and rank of worth (尊贤之等) give the measure from which 礼 arises. The relations are real, but the gradient is asserted from a centre.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：经文先把仁放在人与人的关系中（关系的），随即说亲亲有“杀”（递减）、尊贤有“等”，礼由此而生。脊柱中嵌套的闭包确有次第（喂养闭包在影响闭包之内：Flow.withinInfluence_of_withinFeeding），但这是“触及到哪里”的事实，不是“意义多少”的度量。延续条件下混合的部分不被排序（Transfer.unordered：排序需要一个度量）；以各自依赖为界的中心彼此不一致（Clearing.centers_disagree）；在立场不变的步骤下，意义在一个边界之内成立只能通过对一切成立（unrestricted_iff_presupposed_along）。所以“亲亲之杀”作为意义的递减是理论没有断言的，不是它的定理。分歧不在于有无亲疏，而在于把亲疏读成意义的等差。
passages.reading_en: The text grounds 仁 in human relating and then grades it by kinship and worth as the source of 礼; the spine has nested closures (a fact of reach) but no graded measure of significance, and under the invariance step significance within a boundary holds only by holding for everything, so the gradient is asserted, not derived.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 夫仁者，己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人。能近取譬，可谓仁之方也已。
passages.relational: One's own standing and another's are taken together (立己 with 立人); the method (方) takes the near case, oneself, as the likeness for the other. The relation runs both ways and the self is one pole of it.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“己欲立而立人”说自己的立与他人的立一起成立，不以排除对方为条件。脊柱给出它成立的确切范围：同样的成员，三种走法——两者都超取则都终结，一方取尽则另一方被排除，各取其一则合取在所给之内、三者都持续（Excluding.three_courses）；合取在所给之内，水平永不下降（Flow.level_kept）。但各自可保持不等于共同可保持（ChoicePoint.each_not_joint），且没有任何依据各自情况的规则能判定共同情况（no_rule_decides_joint）。“能近取譬”是以自身为模型推及他人：这种推及恰在世界在这个归并上同样变化之处才正确（Learning.lumped_right_iff）。所以经文的“立人”在合取不超出所给、且他人与己在相关处同样变化时成立，不是普遍成立。
passages.reading_en: Establishing oneself together with others holds exactly where joint taking stays within what is given (three courses, level kept); each being keepable does not make both keepable, and taking oneself as the likeness for another is right only where the other goes alike across that lumping.

fragments: 其恕乎！己所不欲，勿施于人。
passages.relational: 恕 selects what one does to another through one's own valuation: the other is modelled as like oneself. The relation is real (施于人), but it is read through a model centred on the self.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：恕是通过自己的好恶来选择施于他人的行为，即通过一个把他人与己归为一类的模型来选择。脊柱的结构：通过一个映射选择，恰在所关心的性质在映射归并处取同值时才正确（selects_right_through、lumped_right_iff）；映射把两项归并而所关心的性质在其中一项成立、另一项不成立时，没有任何经由这个映射的选择能把它们分开，那需要更细的映射（selects_not_right_of_parted）；两个选项被每个经由映射的估值同样看待，恰在映射把它们绑在一起时（Relabel.valued_alike_iff）。所以“己所不欲勿施于人”在他人的好恶与己在相关处同样变化时可靠；在他人与己不同之处，它会系统地看不见差别。否定形式（勿施）比肯定形式要求更少，但同样受这个范围限制。
passages.reading_en: 恕 selects acts toward another through one's own valuation, a model lumping the other with oneself; the spine says such selection is right exactly where what matters goes alike across that lumping and blind wherever the lumping ties what differs for the other.

fragments: 君子和而不同，小人同而不和。
passages.relational: 和 holds differing parties in one relation; 同 makes them alike. What differentiates is kept within the joint, not removed by it.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：和是不同者在一个关系中相持，同是使之相同。脊柱上：池化的耦合所增加的恰是差别——成员在某处耦合不同，池化的选择就能做到任何单一成员做不到的选择（Web.pool_adds），而池化闭包恰是成员闭包的并（withinClosureOf_iff），所以相同成员的池化什么也不增加；两个构形被合并，二者不能都回返（Merges.not_both_return），有限构形中合并永久丢失一个可能（Merges.loses）；交替的不同范围能到达任一范围单独到不了之处（alternating_beyond_scopes）。这与“和而不同”的结构相同：保留差别的共同关系比求同多出可达之处。经文是对君子与小人相处方式的评价，脊柱只给出结构，不给出“君子”“小人”的评价。
passages.reading_en: A joint that keeps its members different reaches what no member reaches (the pool adds exactly the difference), while making alike merges and loses possibilities; this is the structure of 和而不同, without the passage's evaluation of persons.

fragments: 名不正，则言不顺；言不顺，则事不成
刑罚不中，则民无所措手足
passages.relational: Names, speech, affairs, rites and penalties are linked as a chain of conditions; a fault in naming propagates to whether people can act at all. The relation is between a naming and what it is used to coordinate.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：前两环有脊柱对应：一个投影（命名）恰在被它归为同类的构形同样变化时承载一条规律（carries_law_iff），这时描述才“顺”；把在一切关系中都相同的两个后继区分开来的命名不成立（Twins.naming_not_identifiesAlike）；命名把应当分开的东西绑在一起时，经由它的选择无法选对（selects_not_right_of_parted），这是“事不成”的结构。同时标签本身什么也不承载（Web.rename_tenure 等：改名保持由关系定义的读法），所以“正”不是找到一个本来正确的名字，而是命名与它所归并之物的变化相合。后面的环（礼乐不兴→刑罚不中→民无所措手足）是经文断言的连锁，脊柱不证明。经文语境中的“正名”还指名分（君臣之名），由施政者来正，这一点理论不支持：命名的合宜在于是否承载规律，不在于谁来定。
passages.reading_en: The first links hold on the spine: a naming carries a law exactly where what it lumps goes alike, and a naming tying what differs makes selection through it fail; the further chain to penalties and people's conduct is asserted, and the authority that rectifies names is not a structure the theory supports.

fragments: 名无固宜，约之以命，约定俗成谓之宜，异于约则谓之不宜。
同则同之，异则异之。
passages.relational: A name's fit is not in the thing (无固宜) but formed in joint use (约定俗成); yet naming must follow sameness and difference among things (同则同之，异则异之). Fit is a relation between users, names and what goes alike.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：两半各有脊柱对应。“名无固宜”：标签什么也不承载——改名保持一切由关系定义的读法（Web.rename_renewingIn、Web.rename_tenure）。“同则同之，异则异之”：命名把在一切关系中都相同的东西分开就不成立（Twins.naming_not_identifiesAlike），而在构形由相似决定之处，成立的描述承载一条规律（IdentifiesAlike.carries、carries_law_iff）。所以名的“宜”由约定，名的“实”由同异，二者并不冲突，这与脊柱的结构相同。荀子接着说“其民莫敢托为奇辞以乱正名”，由王者制名并禁止乱名，把约定的形成交给单一中心。SharedCodes 给出两者的关系：改名不改变编码所分别者，也不改变它是否承载规律（run_renamed_tells_apart_iff、renamed_carries_iff）；既不特许形式也不特许形成者的律永不使对称的分歧相合（never_agrees_of_both），中心、偏好之形与听取次序各打破一个对称而在一步内相合（TwoFormations.three_agree）：王者制名是中心一途，约定俗成是次序一途。缺口原拟的陈述（各取其所耦合者中最小编号者之码，恰在每个耦合闭包为全体时静止为同）不成立：在路 a–c–b 上两端各为其耦合中最小者，永不相合（Path.never_agree）；指针律之下相合恰是指针之路相遇（follow_agrees_iff）。
passages.reading_en: Names have no fixed fit (labels carry nothing; renaming keeps every relationally defined reading) yet must follow sameness and difference (a naming that tells apart what is alike does not make sense); how a shared naming forms among many users, which Xunzi hands to the king, is SharedCodes: renaming changes neither what a code tells apart nor what it carries, and a law privileging neither name nor user never settles a symmetric disagreement, so a centre (the king), a preferred form or the order of use must break the symmetry; the gap's coupling-closure form is false (Path.never_agree).

gap.statement: For a finite list of formations each holding a naming map n_i : Config → Name at every step, and a law of naming in which each formation's next map is read through its couplings (for instance: adopt the map of the least-indexed formation it couples with, itself included), prove (1) the maps come to rest all alike from some step on exactly where the coupling closure of every formation is the whole, and give the exact bound on the step; (2) for every renaming σ of names, the run from σ ∘ n reaches σ ∘ (the rest reached from n), so the configurations named fix no name (名无固宜); and (3) the shared map reached carries a law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike (carries_law_iff), so fit (宜) and carrying (实) are independent conditions.
gap.why_it_matters: The spine shows that labels carry nothing but has no law of how a joint naming forms and holds through use; shared readings between people and between people and AI systems are exactly such joint namings, and Xunzi's own text shows the alternative (a single centre fixing names) that the theory would need to answer structurally.
gap.closed: SC (Becoming.SharedCodes, record a-code-formed-between-formations, study section 210); the statement above is kept as proposed, and where the laws differ from it the record and the study section say so (the coupling-closure form proposed for 名无固宜 is false, Path.never_agree).

passages.corrected: SC: Becoming.SharedCodes proved the code formed between formations the reading named as a gap; its laws and record added and the sentence that named the gap replaced (both languages)

fragments: 人何以能群？曰：分。分何以能行？曰：义。
故义以分则和，和则一，一则多力，多力则彊，彊则胜物
passages.relational: The joint (群) is possible through division (分) made to hold by fitness (义). The parts differentiate within the joint; but the joint is then turned outward to overcome things (胜物).
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“群”以“分”为条件，有脊柱对应：各成员各取在所给之内（WithinOwn）不保证合取在所给之内（Exceeding.own_not_joint），合取在所给之内水平不降（Flow.level_kept），合取超出则依赖者终结（Flow.joint_excess_ends）；三种走法中只有分取的走法使全部持续（Excluding.three_courses）。所以“分”在合取被限制在所给之内时是共同延续的条件，这是成立的范围。剩余与分歧：经文接着把群的力量导向“胜物”，把其余视为要克服的对象；而且分在多个条件之间如何可行，脊柱只有单一条件的定律（见 gap）。
passages.reading_en: The joint holds through division where division keeps joint taking within what is given (own counts miss joint excess; within it the level is kept); Xunzi then turns the joint toward overcoming things, and division across several conditions has no law on the spine.

gap.statement: On a flow with finitely many conditions listed, let each formation f present at step t have a need n_f and a list A_f of conditions it can take from. A division at t assigns to each f amounts from the conditions in A_f summing to n_f. Prove: (1) a division with joint taking within what is given at every condition (Flow.WithinJoint at each c) exists exactly where, for every sublist S of the formations, the sum of their needs is at most the sum of what is given at the conditions some member of S can take from (a Hall-type condition, decided for finite lists, with no axiom); (2) under such a division at every step the level of every condition is kept (Flow.level_kept, conditionwise); (3) where the condition fails at a step, every taking that meets every need has joint excess at some condition, so Flow.joint_excess_ends applies there.
gap.why_it_matters: Xunzi's claim that a joint lasts through division is the classical form of a structure the spine states only one condition at a time; the record relative-position-is-zero-sum lists several shared conditions with different needs as open, and the exact division condition would say when differentiation among parts, rather than restraint at one condition, keeps a joint.

fragments: 求而无度量分界，则不能不争；争则乱，乱则穷。
使欲必不穷于物，物必不屈于欲。两者相持而长，是礼之所起也。
passages.relational: Wanting (欲) and things (物) are two sides of one relation: each must not exhaust the other, and both grow while they hold each other (相持而长). The bound (度量分界) is a bound on the relation, not on either side alone.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“求而无度量分界……乱则穷”与脊柱的合取超取定律同构：合取超出所给的每一步都使水平下降，在更新依赖于被更新者时，降到需要之下的合取超取终结依赖它的形成（Flow.joint_excess_ends、joint_excess_ends_at），而各自不超取并不防止合取超取（Exceeding.own_not_joint）。“两者相持而长”对应合取在所给之内时水平不降（Flow.level_kept），以及生成携带补充的要求（Web.embodiedArising_needs_replenishment）。经文把这一界限归于“先王”制礼；脊柱只给出界限是延续的条件，不给出谁来定界。
passages.reading_en: Seeking without a measured bound exhausts what it draws on, while wants and things that hold each other both grow: the spine's joint-excess law and its converse (joint taking within what is given keeps the level) have exactly this structure, though who sets the bound is not part of it.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged

fragments: 君子既得其养，又好其别。曷谓别？曰：贵贱有等，长幼有差，贫富轻重皆有称者也。
passages.relational: After nurture (养), 礼 adds distinction (别): graded positions (贵贱有等). The positions are relative to one another; the grading is asserted as part of what 礼 keeps.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：荀子在“养”之外加上“别”，把贵贱的等级当作礼所维持的东西。脊柱对相对位置有无前提的定律：一个部分相对其余的位置按计数是零和的（RelativePosition.positions_balance），没有任何变化使每个部分的位置上升（not_all_rise），一个部分的上升需要另一个部分的下降（rise_needs_fall）；而在合取超取中终结一个部分的是它对条件的依赖，不是它的位置（Flow.ends_at_race_end）。延续所需的是合取在所给之内（Flow.level_kept），这不需要任何等级。所以“养”的部分与脊柱一致（见 ru-xunzi-li-qi-yu-fen），“别”的部分是理论没有的断言：等级不承载延续，且按计数是零和的。注意“分”（分工、分取）与“等”（位置的贵贱）是两件事，此条只针对后者。
passages.reading_en: Xunzi adds graded rank (别) to nurture (养) as what 礼 keeps; on the spine relative position is zero-sum by counting and what ends a part is its dependence, not its position, while continuation needs only joint taking within what is given, so the rank is asserted, not carried by the structure.

fragments: 人之性恶，其善者伪也。
伪，为也，矫也，矫其本性也。
故圣人化性而起伪
passages.relational: 性 is what is given; 伪 is what is formed by acting. Xunzi's 化性 makes nature changeable within relations of practice, but 性恶 assigns the given a fixed negative value before any relation.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：此条有两层。经文“化性而起伪”说性可被化，是形成的而非固定的（见 ru-xunzi-zheng-ming-wei-cheng 的一致条）。但“人之性恶”给未经形成的所与先赋一个价值，这是理论不做的：被表示的动力学不蕴含任何意义（Web.significance_undetermined），一个规律在活的步骤之外持有什么，没有历史显示（same_histories_iff），前缀不固定下一步（no_prefix_fixes_next）。理论中“规则改变状态的规律”只在规则对状态没有差别处才有状态自己的规律（adaptive_state_law_iff），规则只在读取步改变（Pace.rule_at_reading），这些都不给所与定善恶。杨倞注“矫其本性”比经文更强：把伪读成矫正一个固定的本性，是注的层次，不是荀子的“化”。分歧对称地适用于孟子的性善（见 ru-mengzi-xing-shan）。
passages.reading_en: 化性而起伪 makes nature formed rather than fixed, which the spine supports; but 性恶 gives the unformed given a value before any relation, which the theory does not assert (the dynamics fix no significance), and Yang Liang's gloss 矫其本性 hardens it further into a fixed nature to be bent.

fragments: 不事而自然谓之性。
心虑而能为之动谓之伪；虑积焉，能习焉，而后成谓之伪。
passages.relational: 性 is what goes of itself; 伪 is formed when deliberation accumulates and practice settles (虑积…能习…而后成). A formation's working law is itself formed in its relations of practice.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“虑积焉，能习焉，而后成”与脊柱的规则形成结构相同：规则只在读取步改变，读取步的下一条规则由那里的快构形给出（Pace.rule_at_reading），其余步保持（Pace.rule_kept）；状态只在规则对它没有差别时才有自己的规律（adaptive_state_law_iff）；扰动规则改变结果（Captured.rule_perturbation_changes），而只扰动状态在下一步就被吸收（Law.perturbation_reabsorbed）。所以“伪”对应的是被形成的规则，“性”对应的是规则不起作用时状态自己的走向。这支持“性不是固定的”：一个形成的有效规律是在实践中形成的。脊柱不说所成之伪为善。
passages.reading_en: What goes of itself (性) and what accumulated deliberation and practice form (伪) match the spine's rule formed at reading steps over a state with its own law only where the rule makes no difference; the effective law is formed, not fixed, though nothing here makes the formed rule good.

fragments: 天行有常，不为尧存，不为桀亡。应之以治则吉，应之以乱则凶。
passages.relational: 天 is a regular course (常) that does not answer to anyone's worth; outcomes come from how one responds to it (应之). 天 and the responding part are read in one course, with no will on 天's side.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“天行有常，不为尧存，不为桀亡”对应：规律从展开中读出，某个确定的规律容纳一段历史恰在这段历史一致之处（exists_law_iff），确定规律下构形相同恰在其未来相同（Law.alike_iff_sameFuture），而动力学本身不蕴含任何意义或评价（Web.significance_undetermined）。“应之以治则吉”对应：走过的一步被固定（Run.fixes_of_takes），比较在部分的回应可达范围内决定（comparison_within_response）。这是与董仲舒“天意”（见 ru-dongzhongshu-tian-yi）相反的一条：天不是意志。注意：经文后半转向“制天命而用之”（见 ru-xunzi-zhi-tian-ming），那一部分是分歧。
passages.reading_en: Heaven's course is regular and answers to no one's worth, while outcomes follow from the response: the spine reads laws off the unfolding with no significance in the dynamics and fixes outcomes by the moves taken, the opposite of 天 as a will.

fragments: 大天而思之，孰与物畜而制之！从天而颂之，孰与制天命而用之！
passages.relational: Here the relation to the rest is one of keeping and using (物畜而制之、制天命而用之): the rest becomes material for one part's purposes.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：这一句把人与其余的关系读成“畜而制之”“制而用之”，其余是供一个部分使用的材料。脊柱给出的结构与之相冲突：一个部分不能控制超出其影响闭包之外的东西（Flow.beyond_influence），断点之前没有任何耦合进来的东西界定还有多远（Web.break_not_bounded），自身行为超出耦合闭包的后果不被选中（Flow.consequence_unselected），一个部分可以在自身与其来源之内保持一切而在其外失去（Clearing.loses_beyond），而喂养闭包之内的损失会经由喂养者回到自身（Overshoot.ends_through_feeder）。所以“制天命而用之”所设想的制驭超出部分的可达范围，并把整体当作部分的资源，这是分歧，不是同一结构。
passages.reading_en: Treating the rest as material to be kept and used conflicts with the spine: a part cannot steer beyond its influence closure, cannot register how far off a break is, and can keep everything within itself and its source while losing beyond it.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 是乃仁术也，见牛未见羊也。
是以君子远庖厨也。
passages.relational: The response (不忍) follows what is seen: the ox is coupled into the king's perception, the sheep is not. The relation that moves is the one registered.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“见牛未见羊”与脊柱的选择盲区同构：在耦合闭包之外，经由闭包内任何形成的选择对有无该部分一视同仁（Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling）；行为只在无人耦合的条件上不同，则行为者自身也不能把两种走向分开（Flow.act_unselected），行为超出闭包的后果不被任何成员选中（Flow.consequence_unselected）；在一个条件中的任何差别，凡以水平耦合进来，就使历史不同（observed_level_couples），更多耦合使选择保持并扩大（SelectsThrough.widen）。分歧点：孟子接着说“君子远庖厨”，即安排自己不去耦合，这在脊柱上是缩小选择所经的耦合，它不保持羊或牛的延续，只是使回应不形成。
passages.reading_en: The king's mercy follows what is coupled into his seeing (the ox, not the sheep), as the spine's selection is blind beyond the coupling closure; Mencius' advice to keep away from the kitchen narrows the coupling, which keeps no animal alive and only keeps the response from forming.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 今人乍见孺子将入于井，皆有怵惕恻隐之心；非所以内交于孺子之父母也，非所以要誉于乡党朋友也
passages.relational: The child's danger enters what the onlooker registers, and the response arises there, not through what the onlooker depends on (非所以内交…). The response runs beyond one's feeding closure.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：脊柱给出这一段成立的确切范围。回应只能在登记所及之处形成：凡以水平耦合进来的差别使历史不同（observed_level_couples），比较在部分的回应可达范围之内决定（comparison_within_response、WithinResponse）。孟子强调这回应不经由利害（非所以内交、非所以要誉），即不在喂养闭包内：喂养闭包外的东西不给自己所需之物任何东西（Flow.beyond_gives_nothing），但喂养闭包在影响闭包之内（withinInfluence_of_withinFeeding），所以对陌生孩子的危险的登记在影响闭包内是可能的。脊柱不能给出的是“皆有”：回应在 Response 中是被供给的前提，PoolResponse 证明耦合不固定回应（什么也不交换的规律经由每个耦合）。所以“人皆有恻隐之心”在登记与回应这两层上，登记是必要条件且可证，回应的普遍性是断言。
passages.reading_en: Mencius' response to the child beyond any interest fits the spine's range (registration needs coupling and may lie beyond the feeding closure but within influence), yet that every person has it is not derived: response is a supplied premise and coupling does not fix it.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 故推恩足以保四海，不推恩无以保妻子。
善推其所为而已矣。
passages.relational: Care extends from the near outward (推); keeping the nearest depends on what lies further out. The near and the far are one web of dependence.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“不推恩无以保妻子”有确切的脊柱范围：一个形成的延续依赖其喂养闭包；闭包内的损失可以经由喂养者回到一个本已保持自身支持的形成（Overshoot.ends_through_feeder），喂养者都无支持的消耗至多持续其所消耗者的水平那么多步（consumption_ends_with_feeders）。所以当妻子的延续依赖于恩所未及之处时，不推则不保，这是成立的。“推恩足以保四海”是充分性的断言，脊柱给出反例结构：在每一走法下保持一个部分的活动，既不决定更新，也不决定这次运行对其他形成做什么（Renewable.kept_part_not_renewal）。“推”作为选择的扩大有对应（SelectsThrough.widen），但扩大选择不等于保住所及之物。
passages.reading_en: Not extending care cannot keep even the nearest, where the nearest depends on what care has not reached (a loss within the feeding closure returns through a feeder); that extension suffices to keep the whole is not derived, since keeping a part decides neither renewal nor what the run does to others.

fragments: 君子之于物也，爱之而弗仁；于民也，仁之而弗亲。亲亲而仁民，仁民而爱物。
passages.relational: Responses are graded by relation (亲→仁→爱) and extend to all things; nothing is excluded, but the grade falls with distance from the centre. The relational field is whole; the measure on it is centred.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：一致的部分：嵌套确实存在（喂养闭包在影响闭包内：Flow.withinInfluence_of_withinFeeding），而且孟子的序列延伸到“物”，不排除任何东西，比以自身依赖为界的读法更宽。分歧的部分：把这种嵌套读成回应或意义的等差。延续条件下混合的部分无序（Transfer.unordered：排序需要一个度量）；以依赖为界的不同中心彼此不一致（Clearing.centers_disagree）；在不变性的步骤下，从一个立场在边界内有意义只能通过对一切有意义（unrestricted_iff_presupposed_along、BoundaryInvariant）。脊柱有两层的字典序（Lexical.Above）作为定义，但没有按闭包层级分层的序，也没有它在各立场间是否一致的定理。所以差等是被断言的度量；理论能说的只是：次第是“触及”的事实，不是“意义”的度量（见 gap）。
passages.reading_en: Mencius' gradient (kin, people, things) includes everything but grades it by nearness; the spine has the nesting of closures yet leaves mixed parts unordered under the continuation condition and finds bounded centres disagreeing, and it has no order graded by closure level nor a theorem on whether such an order is the same from every standpoint.

gap.statement: For a web, a centre p and its closures (feeding ⊆ influence ⊆ reach ⊆ system ⊆ whole), let tier_p(f) be the least closure level from p holding f, and let Above_p be the lexical order on level paths that compares retained continuations with significance tier by tier from the nearest (the n-tier extension of Lexical.Above). Prove: (1) Above_p is a strict partial order that orders pairs the continuation condition leaves unordered (Transfer.unordered becomes ordered under Above_p); (2) Above_p and Above_q agree on two level paths exactly where tier_p and tier_q agree in order on the formations where the paths differ, with the clearer's web (Clearing.centers_disagree) as the instance where they part; (3) a tiering is BoundaryInvariant at every standpoint exactly where it is constant on every connected component, so under the invariance step the graded order collapses to the continuation condition's comparisons.
gap.why_it_matters: 差等 (graded care by nearness) is the most used relational ethic in the Confucian line and the sharpest test of the invariance step; the theorem would say exactly which part of graded care survives (an order of attention that follows reach) and which does not (a standpoint-relative measure of significance), instead of leaving the comparison to prose.

fragments: 凡有四端于我者，知皆扩而充之矣，若火之始然，泉之始达。
茍能充之，足以保四海；茍不充之，不足以事父母。
passages.relational: The four beginnings are responses already in relation; extending them (扩充) lets them grow like a fire catching or a spring breaking through. Growth is of a responsiveness within relations, not of a substance.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“若火之始然，泉之始达”的结构在脊柱上是回路的形成：一个交换开始回应它所给予的水平时形成一个自环（responds_to_own_level），在阈值处回路形成并从此加倍（Closing.Threshold.forms、carried_runaway），回路形成之前所携带的量至多是多项式的（carried_le_polynomial_before），而到达阈值之前的进程不显示它会不会形成（Threshold.unforeseen）。所以“端”经扩充而自我维持地增长，在回路形成的条件下成立。范围的修正：增长本身是中性的，脊柱上同样的结构也给出失控；“足以保四海”“不足以事父母”是断言，脊柱只说扩充前后增长的形态不同。
passages.reading_en: Beginnings that, once extended, grow like a fire catching match the spine's loop forming at a threshold and doubling thereafter (before it, growth is at most polynomial); the same structure also gives runaway, and that extension suffices to keep the four seas is asserted.

fragments: 人见其濯濯也，以为未尝有材焉，此岂山之性也哉？
茍得其养，无物不长；茍失其养，无物不消。
passages.relational: The bare mountain is the outcome of a history of cutting and grazing against nightly regrowth; what one sees now is read wrongly as the mountain's nature. 性 is read off a history, and the history is relational (斧斤、牛羊、雨露).
passages.reading: AI 的读法：两点都有脊柱定律。其一，生成携带补充的要求：在后来的步骤仍有成员出现的族群，补充反复出现（Web.embodiedArising_needs_replenishment），而反复的取用超过补充会终结依赖者（Flow.joint_excess_ends），这是“得其养则长，失其养则消”。其二，“以为未尝有材”是错误的归因：错误的投影把不造成任何差别的东西读成差别（Confound.misattributes），前缀不固定下一步（no_prefix_fixes_next），未走过的一步不被固定（Run.not_fixes_of_untaken）——从濯濯的现状推断“性”就是从一段记录推断一条规律。这一段读出的性是历史的结果，与告子上·2“水之就下”的固定性相反（见 ru-mengzi-xing-shan）。
passages.reading_en: The bare mountain is the record of cutting and grazing outrunning regrowth, not the mountain's nature: the spine's laws that generation needs replenishment and that a record misattributes and fixes no untaken move carry this exactly.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged

fragments: 人性之善也，犹水之就下也。人无有不善，水无有不下。
passages.relational: Nature is given a fixed direction with a value (善), like water's fixed tendency downward; the relations that act on it (搏而跃之) are treated as deflections of a prior tendency.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：此句给人性一个先于关系的固定方向并赋予价值，以水之就下作比。理论不断言这一点：被表示的动力学不蕴含意义（Web.significance_undetermined），规律在活的步骤之外持有什么没有历史显示（same_histories_iff），状态只在规则不起作用时有自己的规律（adaptive_state_law_iff）。若把“就下”读成吸引，脊柱也只说每个规律吸引恰是不回返者（Law.drawn_iff_not_returns），吸引本身不是善。孟子自己在下文承认“搏而跃之，可使过颡”，即走向由作用于它的关系决定。分歧与荀子“性恶”对称：两者都在关系之前给所与定值。
passages.reading_en: Mencius gives human nature a fixed, valued direction like water flowing down; the theory gives the given no value before relations (the dynamics fix no significance), and Mencius' own next line, that water can be made to leap, concedes that the course depends on what acts on it.

fragments: 尽其心者，知其性也。知其性，则知天矣。
万物皆备于我矣，反身而诚，乐莫大焉。强恕而行，求仁莫近焉。
passages.relational: The self is read as holding its relations to all things (皆备于我), and knowing one's heart is read as a route to knowing 天. The whole is approached from within the self, then carried outward by 恕.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：一个读法成立，一个不成立。成立的：一个延续族群的区域不是切口，传递离开它（Flow.region_not_a_cut），所以“我”由与万物的关系构成，在这个意义上万物之关系“备于我”。不成立的：从自身穷尽整体。脊柱上，以自身构形为断言的框架没有一个构形实现所有关于构形的断言模式（Frame.self_incomplete、Diagonal.claims_incomplete）；一个断言只能经由耦合进来的差别被排除（Web.Excludes.not_of_alike）；影响闭包之外的东西从不与闭包成员所依赖的条件交换（Flow.beyond_influence）。所以“尽心知性知天”在部分的登记与影响所及之内成立，超出这个范围的“知天”不是由反身所能得到的。孟子紧接着说“强恕而行”，即还要向他人走出去，这与范围的修正方向一致。
passages.reading_en: That the self is made of its relations to all things holds (a continuing family's region is not a cut); that turning inward exhausts the whole does not, since no frame realizes every claim about itself and nothing beyond one's influence closure registers, so knowing 天 through one's heart holds only within one's reach.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 天不言，以行与事示之而已矣。
天视自我民视，天听自我民听
passages.relational: 天 does not speak; what 天 'gives' is read off acts and events and through the seeing and hearing of the people. 天 is read through relations, not as a speaker.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“天不言，以行与事示之”对应规律从展开中读出（exists_law_iff、Law.alike_iff_sameFuture），没有一个在历史之外发话的来源。“天视自我民视”对应池化的登记：经由单一成员耦合的选择等于经由池化耦合的选择，恰在该成员视为相同的，每个成员也都视为相同之处（Web.pooled_iff_member），否则池化多出单一中心看不见的分别；池外的东西不被池化选择选中（unselected_beyond_pool），把被影响者纳入池中可以补上单一中心的盲区（Clearing.pool_closes_gap）。所以天在这里是经由众人的登记读出的，不是意志。剩余：孟子仍说“天与之”“天受之”，保留了给予者的语法；脊柱只承接“示之以行与事”的结构。
passages.reading_en: Heaven does not speak and is read off acts and events and through the people's seeing: the spine reads laws off the unfolding and pools registration across members, while Mencius' remaining grammar of 天 giving is not carried.

fragments: 心正而后身修，身修而后家齐，家齐而后国治，国治而后天下平。
其本乱而末治者否矣。
passages.relational: Heart, person, household, state and world are nested; order is said to pass from the inner to the outer, and disorder at the root rules out order at the branches. The nesting is relational; the passage asserts a direction of conditioning.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：经文含两个方向，脊柱分别给出。必要性方向（“其本乱而末治者否矣”：外有序则内有序）成立：一个部分的水平在一个区域内容纳的，在其内的每个区域都容纳（Web.AdmitsWithin.narrow），包含恰是在每个区域内成立（includes_iff_within_every）；对每一走法都不离开的守护而言，共同守护恰是各自守护（Viability.kernel_and_iff）。充分性方向（“身修而后家齐…”）不普遍成立：可以在自身与来源之内保持一切而在其外失去（Clearing.loses_beyond），各自可保持而共同不可保持（ChoicePoint.each_not_joint），而且外层的关系可以由整体持有而不由任何部分持有（whole_not_in_pairs）。所以大学的次第作为条件链是“内是外的必要条件”，不是“内足以致外”；atlas 自己的界限说明也指出它不是经验证明的普遍因果链。
passages.reading_en: The necessity direction (no ordered branches with a disordered root) holds, since what holds within a region holds within every region inside it; the sufficiency chain (an ordered person orders the household and outward) fails in general, since a part can keep everything within itself and its source while losing beyond, and the outer relation can be held by the whole and by no part.

fragments: 喜怒哀乐之未发，谓之中；发而皆中节，谓之和。
致中和，天地位焉，万物育焉。
passages.relational: The measure of a part's responses (中节) is set in relation to the whole (天地位、万物育). The passage links the part's balance to the whole's order.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“发而皆中节”是部分的回应保持在度之内；“致中和，天地位焉，万物育焉”把部分的中和与整体的位育连起来。脊柱给出这一联系成立的范围：部分未触及的东西，有它无它同样被容纳（Flow.Balances.admits_unreached），任何覆盖部分可达范围的意义，比较有无它的水平时与延续条件一致（comparison_within_reach）。所以部分的中和决定的是它可达范围之内的位育；超出可达范围的天地之位不由它决定，而且部分可以在其内保持一切而在其外失去（Clearing.loses_beyond）。范围的修正：这是“在所及之内”的命题，不是“致中和即天地位”。朱熹注把它读成“天地万物本吾一体”，那是注的层次（见程颢“一体”条）。“发而皆中节”的“节”也可读为（AI 读法）回应以距离为界：与偏离相反的回应在两侧都不超过它与 m 的距离，恰是下一水平落在 m 与当前水平之间（`Flow.withinGap_iff_between`），这时水平在距离用尽时定于 m（`Flow.settles`）；不中节的回应越过 m（`Flow.crosses_of_above`）。这是一种耦合的性质，不涉及天地之位。
passages.reading_en: A part's measured responses decide what lies within its reach (what it does not reach is admitted alike with and without it), so 致中和 orders 天地 and 万物 only within that reach, not as such. 发而皆中节 can also be read (AI) as a response within the gap: opposing, it stays within the level's distance to m on both sides exactly where the next level lies between m and the present one, and the level then settles at m (Flow.withinGap_iff_between, Flow.settles); a response beyond it crosses m.
passages.corrected: RG: 中节 read as a response within the gap, the bound two-sided regulation proves exact

fragments: 万物并育而不相害，道并行而不相悖。
passages.relational: Many things grow together without harming one another; many ways run side by side without contradiction. Plurality is held within one whole.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：两半各有一个成立的范围。“并育而不相害”：同样的成员可以分取而全部持续，也可以一方取尽而排除另一方（Excluding.three_courses），合取在所给之内水平不降（Flow.level_kept）；两部分的计划同时运行，在联合步投影到各部分、计划相容时保持两者的守护（Viability.Plan.zip_keeps），但没有依据各自可保持性的规则判定共同可保持性（no_rule_decides_joint）。“并行而不相悖”：各语境所显示的恰在交界处一致时才拼合（Contextual.glues_iff_agree），而各语境各自一致仍可以不是任何整体的部分（Specker.no_whole）。所以经文描述的“天地之所以为大”在这些条件下成立，不是无条件的。
passages.reading_en: Growing together without harm holds where joint taking stays within what is given and plans are compatible, and ways running side by side without contradiction hold where readings agree where contexts meet; neither is unconditional.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 诚者自成也；而道，自道也。
诚者，物之终始，不诚无物。
成己，仁也；成物，知也。
passages.relational: 诚 is self-completing (自成) and is the beginning and end of things; completing oneself is already completing things (成物). Self and things are formed in one movement.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“自成”在脊柱上的对应是：依赖于自身的具身关系项在活动期间作为条件存立（Web.SelfBearing.stands），它的自我依赖恰在它活动时被满足，不记录活动以外的任何东西（SelfBearing.met_iff）。“物之终始，不诚无物”对应：出现与消失是同一变化的三种读法（Web.change_readings），一个整体只经由其部分不断生成而持续（Web.Whole.needs_arising）。“成己…所以成物”对应：具身成员的出现补充其族群（Web.Embodied.replenishes）。范围：脊柱中的“自成”只是活动本身，记录不了更多；经文中诚作为“天之道”与“至诚无息”的德性含义，以及“成己”必然“成物”，不由这些定律给出。
passages.reading_en: Self-completion matches a self-bearing relatum standing while active (its self-dependence records nothing beyond activity), and 不诚无物 matches a whole persisting only through its parts' generation; 诚 as the way of heaven, and that completing oneself always completes things, go beyond these laws.

fragments: 故人不独亲其亲，不独子其子
力，恶其不出于身也，不必为己。
各亲其亲，各子其子，货力为己
passages.relational: 大同 does not bound care by one's own kin (不独亲其亲) and does not direct effort to oneself (不必为己); 小康 bounds both by the household (各亲其亲、为己). Two ways of drawing the region within which continuation counts.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：大同与小康在脊柱上对应两种边界的划法。小康的“各亲其亲，货力为己”是以各自依赖为界的意义：以依赖为界的中心容许搭便车者并彼此不一致（Clearing.centers_disagree、clearer_loses_dweller）。大同的“不独亲其亲”是以整体为界的意义：以整体为界的意义就是延续条件（bounded_whole）；在一个形成的喂养闭包是整体之处，两者在每个比较上一致（Flow.within_closure_iff_retains），否则分开。从小康到大同需要的是不变性的步骤（unrestricted_iff_presupposed_along），这是条件，理论不断言它。范围的修正：经文把大同说成过去曾行之道，是叙述，不是推导；脊柱只说两种边界各给出什么，以及它们在哪里分开。
passages.reading_en: 小康 bounds care by the household and 大同 by the whole: the spine shows bounded centres license the free rider and disagree, that significance bounded by the whole is the continuation condition, and that the move from one to the other is the invariance step, a condition the theory does not assert.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged; record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 极重不可反。识其重而亟反之，可也。反之，力也。识不早，力不易也。
passages.relational: 势 is the weighting of the whole's tendencies (轻重); reversal depends on recognizing the weight early. What can be done depends on where the course already is.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：三处都有脊柱定律。“极重不可反”：每个规律吸引的恰是不回返的构形（Law.drawn_iff_not_returns），被吸入的不再回来（DrawnInto.never_back）。“识不早，力不易”：一个低于所接收的回返映射在差额那么多轮内闭合，这个界是确切的（LoopReturn.closes_within、closes_within_exact）——偏得越多，收回所需越多。“识”之难：断点之前没有任何耦合进来的东西界定还有多远（Web.break_not_bounded）。所以周敦颐说的是吸引、闭合的轮数与登记的界限，与脊柱同构。“天乎？人也”把责任归于人，这一归属脊柱不处理。
passages.reading_en: Extreme weight cannot be reversed, reversal takes force, and late recognition makes it harder: the spine proves that what is drawn in never returns, that closing a difference takes as many turns as the difference, and that nothing coupled in bounds the distance to the break.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged; record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 气之聚散于太虚，犹冰凝释于水，知太虚即气，则无无。
太虚不能无气，气不能不聚而为万物，万物不能不散而为太虚。
passages.relational: Gathering and dispersing are one process in one continuum (太虚即气); there is no void apart from it (无无). Things are passing forms (客形) of one unfolding.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“聚散”“凝释”是同一变化：出现与消失、形成与解散、存立与不存立是同一变化的三种读法（Web.change_readings）；有限族群中出现反复恰在消失反复时（arising_recurs_iff），任一段中出现与消失之差至多为成员数（keep_pace）；整体只经由部分的生成而持续（Whole.needs_arising）。“太虚不能无气……不能不散而为太虚”的循环与这些定律同构。剩余：张载的“气”可被读成一种基质，脊柱不设任何基质，只有活动、依赖与存立的变化；此条只承接“一个连续体中的聚散”这一结构，不承接气作为质料。
passages.reading_en: Gathering and dispersing in one continuum match the spine's reading of arising and ceasing as one change, recurring together in a finite family; the spine carries the structure, not 气 as a stuff.

passages.locator: 乾称篇第十七·西铭段（atlas 篇名作“干称”）
fragments: 故天地之塞，吾其体；天地之帅，吾其性。民吾同胞，物吾与也。
passages.relational: One's body is what fills heaven and earth and one's nature what leads them; people are siblings and things companions. The self is a place in the whole, and kinship is extended along the whole's generation.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“天地之塞，吾其体”对应：延续族群的区域不是切口，传递穿过边界（Flow.region_not_a_cut、boundary_crossed）。“民吾同胞”对应：每一代由前一代给出的世代由后裔相连（Brood.descent_connected），在关系中立的条件下，看重一个形成的任何事件会到达其后裔的每个活事件（Flow.descent_reaches）。所以“同胞”“吾与”在结构上是同源与边界不成切口。剩余与分歧：西铭接着说“大君者，吾父母宗子；其大臣，宗子之家相也”，把整体组织成家族的尊卑角色，这一层是断言的等级，不在脊柱上；Flow.descent_reaches 还依赖关系中立这个前提。
passages.reading_en: My body as what fills heaven and earth and all people as siblings match the spine's results that a continuing family's region is no cut and that generations are connected by descent; the household ranking the 西铭 then lays over the whole is asserted, not carried.

fragments: 仁者以天地万物为一体，莫非己也。
如手足不仁，气已不贯
passages.relational: 仁 is to take heaven, earth and all things as one body with oneself; 不仁 is numbness, the loss of connection (气已不贯). The self's region is drawn at the whole.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：内容上一致，地位上分歧。“手足不仁，气已不贯”的结构在脊柱上成立：凡以水平耦合进来的差别才使历史有别（Web.observed_level_couples），耦合闭包之外选择是盲的（Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling）——麻木就是耦合断了。“以天地万物为一体”对应：把自己的边界画在整体，在每个容许区域上不变的前提，恰是延续条件（unrestricted_iff_presupposed_along、BoundaryInvariant），而不变性恰是从前提到延续条件的条件句（boundaryInvariant_iff_conditional）。分歧在地位：程颢把一体说成仁之所是，是体认到的事实；理论把它作为延续条件加上不变性的步骤，条件本身不被断言，其根据与必要性是开放的。
passages.reading_en: Numbness as lost connection matches the spine (only what couples in registers), and taking all things as one body with oneself matches the continuation condition reached by the invariance step; but Cheng Hao states it as what 仁 is, while the theory holds it as a condition it does not assert.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

passages.work: 二程（《近思录》卷一第22–23条，传统归程颢）
fragments: 观天地生物气象。
万物之生意最可观，此元者善之长也。斯可谓仁也。
passages.relational: One observes the whole's generating (生物气象) and names the vitality of things (生意) the first of goods (善之长) and 仁. Generation is seen in relation and then valued.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：内容上与条件下的定理一致，地位上分歧。在延续条件之下，生命意义在每个框架上对每种“生”的读法成立（livingSignificance_of_unrestricted），把“更好”读作保持并增加有意义者时就是扩大可形成者（Web.widens_iff_retains_adds），这与“生意……善之长”的内容相合。但理论不断言条件（Unrestricted 只是一个前提）：在无物有意义处每条路径保持每条路径，动力学不蕴含生命意义（Web.significance_undetermined）；条件本身不排序，混合的部分无序（Transfer.unordered），排序在于把扩大称为更好（C）和不变性的步骤。王夫之引“程子谓雞雛可以觀仁”，读作“觀天地化機之仁也”（V4SO001），同样把生成称为仁，是另一层的读法。所以“生即仁”在理论中是条件下的定理，在程颢是直接的认取。
passages.reading_en: Naming the vitality of things the first of goods and 仁 agrees in content with theorems under the continuation condition, but the theory holds the condition unasserted and the dynamics fix no value, so Cheng Hao's direct identification diverges in status (Wang Fuzhi's reading of the chick passage does the same on another layer).
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged; record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

passages.work: 二程（《近思录》卷一第12条；第34条明道语）
fragments: 有感必有应。凡有动皆为感，感则必有应。所应复为感，所感复有应，所以不已也。
天地之间，只有一个感与应而已。
passages.relational: Every movement is a stimulus that gets a response, and the response becomes a new stimulus: the whole is one web of mutual response (只有一个感与应), unceasing because it loops.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“所应复为感，所感复有应，所以不已”是一个回路。脊柱给出“不已”成立的确切条件：每个环节至少传出所接收的，回路就保持差别（LoopReturn.loop_kept）；回路闭合需要某个环节传出少于所接收（closing_needs_less）；整数强度下回路要么在第一轮闭合、要么保持、要么失控，没有中间（nothing_between）；回路由连接一条链的耦合闭合而形成（forms_by_closing）。所以感应不已恰在没有环节衰减时成立。“有感必有应”作为普遍断言是前提：在 Response 中回应是被供给的，而比较在回应可达范围内决定（comparison_within_response）。“天地之间只有一个感与应”是关系本体的强表述，脊柱的回路定律承接其结构，不承接其普遍性。
passages.reading_en: Response becoming stimulus again is a loop, and the spine gives the exact condition for 不已: a loop keeps a difference where no link gives back less, and closing needs such a link; that every stimulus is answered is a supplied premise, not a theorem.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged

passages.work: 程颐《周易程氏传》复卦彖注（易道包 CL-CY-011）
fragments: 一陽復於下乃天地生物之心也
盖不知動之端乃天地之心也
passages.relational: Return (复) is the first stirring of movement at the bottom; the whole's 'heart' is seen in the beginning of movement, not in stillness. Generation is read in the course of return.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：程颐把复卦的一阳来复读作“天地生物之心”，并纠正以静见天地之心的旧说：天地之心在“动之端”。脊柱对应：有限构形中无损的规律恰是回返的规律（Law.lossless_iff_returns），有界整体中不断的生成是回返（Flow.whole_not_new_of_rest_idle），新的东西由其余或跨边界给出（new_from_rest_or_open）；“静”不是停止：规律的止息由一个满足目标的停留步刻画（Law.rests_iff），那仍是一步。所以“动之端”而非“静”与脊柱一致。范围与分歧：把回返称为“天地生物之心”赋予天地一个“心”，这一语法脊柱不承接（见朱熹“无心之心”条）；回返本身也不是善。
passages.reading_en: Cheng Yi sees the whole's 'heart' in the first stirring of return rather than in stillness; the spine agrees that lossless laws are exactly returning ones and that unceasing generation in a bounded whole is return, but does not carry the attribution of a heart to heaven and earth.

fragments: 性即理也。天下之理，原其所自，未有不善。
passages.relational: 性 is identified with 理, and 理 at its origin is said to be wholly good. The law is placed before and above the course, and given a value at its source.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：两处分歧。其一，规律的地位：脊柱中规律从展开中读出，某个确定规律容纳一段历史恰在历史一致之处（exists_law_iff），两个规律容纳同样的历史恰在它们有同样的活的步骤之处，死端无历史显示（same_histories_iff）；理作为对结构与变化之规律的建模，是在归并下同样变化的东西（Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped）。“原其所自”把理放在历史之前，是理论没有的。其二，价值：“未有不善”给规律赋予源头上的善，而动力学不蕴含意义（Web.significance_undetermined）。这条与程颐“动之端”条不同：那条在变化中读心，这条在变化之前立理。
passages.reading_en: Identifying nature with 理 and calling 理 at its origin wholly good places the law before the course and gives it a value at its source; on the spine a law is read off histories (two laws admitting the same histories differ only in dead ends) and the dynamics carry no value.

passages.work: 朱熹（《朱子语类》卷九十八，论西铭）
passages.locator: 卷九十八·张子书一（西铭），人杰录
fragments: 安得谓天地无心、情乎！
程先生说‘天地以生物为心’，最好，此乃是无心之心也。
passages.relational: Heaven and earth are said to have a heart, namely generating things, but a heart without a mind (无心之心): a direction of the whole with no deliberating centre.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：朱熹在“天地有心”与“天地无志”之间取了中间：天地以生物为心，但是“无心之心”。脊柱给出这一中间立场成立的范围：生成携带补充的要求（Web.embodiedArising_needs_replenishment），规律从展开中读出（exists_law_iff、Law.alike_iff_sameFuture），所以“以生物为心”可以读成整体之生成的规律性；中心不是沿依赖导出的（Clearing.center_not_derived），动力学不蕴含意义（Web.significance_undetermined），所以“无心”——没有一个审议的中心——与脊柱一致。范围的修正：朱熹仍用“心、情”的语法并反问“安得谓天地无心”，脊柱不承接这一语法；它承接的只是“无心之心”所指的无中心的规律性。
passages.reading_en: Zhu Xi's 'heart without a mind' reads the whole's generating as a direction with no deliberating centre, which the spine supports (laws read off the unfolding, no centre derived), while his insistence that heaven and earth do have a heart keeps a grammar the spine does not carry.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged

passages.work: 朱熹（《朱子语类》卷九十八，论西铭）
passages.locator: 卷九十八·论西铭“理一而分殊”
fragments: 言理一而不言分殊，则为墨氏兼爱；言分殊而不言理一，则为杨氏为我。
passages.relational: One pattern (理一) holds across differentiated positions (分殊): the same 理 gives different duties at different places in the relations. Both one and many are kept.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：朱熹指出两种失败，各有脊柱对应。“理一而不言分殊”：对一切有意义而无度量，混合的部分无序（Transfer.unordered：排序需要一个度量）。“分殊而不言理一”：以各自依赖为界的中心容许搭便车者并彼此不一致（Clearing.centers_disagree、clearer_loses_dweller）。而“理一分殊”本身有一个成立的结构：语境索引的读法符合一切所示（Contextual.indexed_fits），而无语境的读法只在各语境一致时存在（fitsFree_iff）——同一规律在不同位置给出不同的读法。范围：脊柱给出“一规律、诸语境读法”的结构，但“分殊”所含的等差（亲疏之分）需要一个度量，脊柱只有两层字典序的定义（Lexical.Above），没有按关系层级分层的序（见孟子“亲亲而仁民”条的 gap）。层次：墨、杨在此是朱熹的论辩性概括，不是两家原文。
passages.reading_en: Zhu Xi's two failures match the spine (significance for all without a measure leaves mixed parts unordered; centres bounded by their own dependence disagree), and one law read differently in each context matches context-indexed readings; the grading inside 分殊 needs a measure the spine does not have.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged; record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

passages.work: 朱熹（《朱子语录》，戴震《孟子字义疏证》注中所引）
passages.locator: 《孟子字义疏证》卷上·理，〈〉内引朱子语
fragments: 理與氣決是二物，但在物上看，則二物渾淪，不可分開各在一處，然不害二物之各為一物也。
則疑此氣是依傍道理行
若有理則止是個淨潔空闊底世界，無形跡，他卻不會造作
passages.relational: 理 and 气 are two things, inseparable in any thing yet each one thing; 气 'goes along' 理, and 理 alone would be a clean, empty world. Relations are read through two prior kinds, with 理 logically first.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：这是此线中最清楚的“两种实在”的结构，与脊柱冲突。脊柱上没有两种实在：过程与框架都是展开的读法；某个确定规律容纳一段历史恰在历史一致之处（exists_law_iff），一段历史所显示的规律恰在历史一致处是确定的（shown_determined_iff），保持其历史的运行所显示的规律只容纳这段历史（Run.keepHistory_shown），两个规律容纳同样历史恰在活的步骤相同时，规律在活的步骤之外持有的东西（死端）没有历史显示（same_histories_iff）。所以一个先于历史给出的“理”，相对于历史只多出从未走过的步；“净洁空阔底世界”在脊柱上没有对应物。朱熹自己在此留有余地（“不消如此說……皆不可得而推究”），说的是逻辑上的先后，不是时间上的；但即使是逻辑上的先在，也是理论所不立的。层次：这是戴震在注中引用的朱子语，用来批评，引用不是朱熹原书的上下文。
passages.reading_en: Zhu Xi's 理 and 气 as two things, with 气 going along 理 and 理 alone a clean empty world, is a two-realities structure the spine rejects: a law is read off the histories, and a law given before them adds only steps never taken.

passages.work: 朱熹《周易本义》系辞上注（易道包 CL-ZX-011）
passages.locator: 系辞上传·一阴一阳之谓道，本义注
fragments: 隂陽迭運者氣也其理則所謂道
passages.relational: The alternation of yin and yang is the course (气); its pattern (理) is what the text calls 道. Pattern is read in the alternation.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：在这条注中，理是阴阳交替这一进程的“理”，即进程的规律性。脊柱对应：规律在确定规律下由“未来相同”读出（Law.alike_iff_sameFuture），理作为对结构与变化之规律的建模，是在归并下同样变化的东西（Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped），一个投影恰在其归并之物同样变化时承载规律（carries_law_iff）。在这一句的范围内，理是进程的规律，与脊柱一致。范围的修正：朱熹在同书别处说“卦爻隂陽皆形而下者其理則道也”（CL-ZX-014），把理放到形而上，与气分层，那就是“理气二物”的分歧（见 ru-zhuxi-li-qi-er-wu）。此条只取“迭运之理”这一义。
passages.reading_en: Here 理 is the pattern of the alternating course, which matches the spine's law read off what goes alike; elsewhere Zhu Xi places 理 above form, apart from 气, which is the divergence recorded separately.

passages.work: 朱熹《大学章句》格物补传
fragments: 莫不因其已知之理而益穷之，以求至乎其极。
至于用力之久，而一旦豁然贯通焉。
passages.relational: Knowing proceeds from 理 already known to more, thing by thing, until at once everything connects (贯通). Knower and things are related through investigation.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“因其已知之理而益穷之”与脊柱的学习结构一致：以变化的行动反驳错误的投影（Confound.varied_refutes），在套索进程上，“消除会停下来”是未被反驳的，但前缀从不显示它停下了（Learning.rest_unrefuted、no_prefix_fixes_next）。“一旦豁然贯通”声称一个完成：众物表里精粗无不到。脊柱上没有一族由其所读者索引的断言能实现每一种断言模式（Diagonal.claims_incomplete），对角线始终开放（Learning.diagonal_open）。所以格物作为逐步的反驳与归并是成立的；豁然贯通作为“无不到”的完成超出范围，至多是“未被反驳的停下”。层次：这是朱熹为《大学》补写的传，不是经文。
passages.reading_en: Extending known patterns thing by thing matches learning by refutation; the sudden complete penetration (豁然贯通) exceeds it, since an end of refutation is unrefuted but never shown by a prefix and no family of claims realizes every pattern.

fragments: 心外无理，心外无事。
passages.relational: Pattern and affairs are said to have no place outside the heart: the relation between knower and world is folded into the knowing side.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：在传习录上卷的语境中，“心外无理”首先指行为之理（孝之理不在父身上），这一义见 WANG-YANGMING 章的整体重建，不在此重做。此条只取字面的普遍义：“心外无事”。脊柱上这是分歧：没有任何东西读取的差别不被带到任何地方，但它仍然在那里——储量仍高出 d（unread_carried_nowhere）；断点之前没有耦合进来的东西界定还有多远（Web.break_not_bounded）；自身行为超出耦合闭包的后果不被选中却照样发生（Flow.consequence_unselected）；影响闭包之外的东西从不与闭包内所依赖的条件交换（Flow.beyond_influence）。所以登记之外有事，且事之理不在登记之内穷尽（Frame.self_incomplete）。王夫之“目所不見非無色也”（见 ru-wangfuzhi-mu-suo-bu-jian）是此线内部的反驳。
passages.reading_en: Read as a general claim (no affairs outside the heart), this diverges from the spine, where a difference nothing reads is still there though carried nowhere and the consequences of one's act beyond one's coupling still occur; the narrower sense (the pattern of conduct lies in the responding relation) is left to the existing Wang Yangming chapter.
passages.corrected: record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

fragments: 知是行的主意，行是知的功夫；知是行之始，行是知之成。
passages.relational: Knowing and acting are one process seen from two ends: knowing begins acting and acting completes knowing. Neither is a separate faculty.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“行是知之成”与脊柱的实验结构一致：走过的一步被固定，每个容纳运行步骤的确定过程都把它送到运行所到之处（Run.fixes_of_takes）；未走过的一步不被固定（Run.not_fixes_of_untaken）；一次场合代表其类中的每个构形，恰在步骤经由投影成为确定过程之处（Run.generalizes）；以变化的行动反驳错误的投影（Confound.varied_refutes）。所以关于一个行动之结果的知，恰在行动中完成；未行之知是未固定的。WANG-YANGMING 章已有一个较早的整体重建（旧词汇、旧模块），此条把其中“知行”一点接到脊柱的实验定律上，不重做该章。
passages.reading_en: Acting completes knowing: on the spine a move taken is fixed and an untaken move is not, so knowledge of an act's outcome is completed only in taking it, which links the older Wang Yangming chapter to the experiment laws.

fragments: 理也者，情之不爽失也；未有情不得而理得者也。
欲，其物；理，其則也。
passages.relational: 理 is the pattern of feelings and desires when they do not miss (不爽失); it is the rule (則) of the things themselves (欲，其物). Pattern lies in the relations of living beings, not above them.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：戴震的两句与脊柱同构。“欲，其物；理，其則”：规律是从所发生者读出的（exists_law_iff），一个投影恰在其归并之物同样变化时承载规律（carries_law_iff），理作为建模是归并下同样变化者（goAlike_iff_lumped），不是第二种实在。“理也者，情之不爽失也”：一个归并的推及恰在世界在其归并处取同值时才对（Learning.lumped_right_iff）；把情所区分的东西归为一类，经由它的选择无法选对（selects_not_right_of_parted）——“情不得而理得”在结构上不可能。这是对朱熹“理气二物”（见该条）的此线内部的反驳。
passages.reading_en: Dai Zhen's 理 as the rule of desires themselves and as feelings not missing matches the spine: a law is read off what happens, and a lumping is right exactly where what it lumps goes alike, so a 理 that misses feelings cannot select rightly.

fragments: 尊者以理責卑，長者以理責幼，貴者以理責賤，雖失，謂之順
於是下之人不能以天下之同情、天下所同欲達之於上
人死於法，猶有憐之者；死於理，其誰憐之！
passages.relational: One position's 理 is applied to others while their feelings and desires cannot reach it (不能…達之於上). The relation is one-way: the selection runs through one centre's model, and the others' registration is cut off.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“以理杀人”的结构在脊柱上是：经由一个映射的每个估值对两个选项一视同仁，恰在映射把它们绑在一起时（Relabel.valued_alike_iff），经由它的选择不能分开它所绑在一起的（selects_not_right_of_parted）；选择在选择者的耦合闭包之外是盲的（Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling），一个池的行为对其耦合闭包之外的后果同样不被选中（act_unselected_pool）。戴震的对治“以天下之同情、天下所同欲”在结构上是池化：池外的东西不被池化选择选中（unselected_beyond_pool），池化可以补上单一中心的盲区（Clearing.pool_closes_gap）。“死于理，其谁怜之”说的是：当伤害被一个归并归入“合理”时，它在选择中消失了。
passages.reading_en: Killing by 理 is selection through one position's model that ties together what the others' feelings separate, with their registration cut off; the spine proves such selection blind to what the model ties and shows pooling the others' coupling closes the gap, which is Dai Zhen's remedy.

fragments: 仁者，生生之德也
一人遂其生，推之而與天下共遂其生，仁也。
passages.relational: 仁 is the virtue of continuing generation; one's own living on is extended to the living on of all together (共遂其生). The self's continuation and the whole's are one movement of extension.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：“一人遂其生，推之而与天下共遂其生”在脊柱上分两步。第一步，自身的延续依赖其喂养闭包；在喂养闭包是整体之处，有界的意义与延续条件在每个比较上一致（Flow.within_closure_iff_retains），否则需要不变性的步骤才从自身推到整体（unrestricted_iff_presupposed_along）。第二步，“共遂”可行的条件：合取在所给之内时全部持续（Excluding.three_courses、Flow.level_kept）。“仁者，生生之德也”把生生称为德，与条件下的定理同内容（livingSignificance_of_unrestricted），地位上是断言。所以此句在“推”需要不变性步骤、“共”需要合取在所给之内这两个条件下成立。
passages.reading_en: Extending one's own living on to all living on together needs the invariance step (or a feeding closure that is the whole) and is feasible where joint taking stays within what is given; calling continuing generation 仁 agrees in content with theorems under the condition, not with the theory's assertions.
passages.corrected: names follow the renamed declarations (R22, R30; tables in development/r22-names and development/r30-names), statements unchanged; record ids follow the renamed records (R35; receipts in _process/architecture/renames), claims unchanged

passages.work: 黄宗羲《明夷待访录·原君》
fragments: 古者以天下為主，君為客
以我之大私為天下之大公。
passages.relational: The whole (天下) is what is served; the one who holds office is a guest within it. The inversion (以君為主) makes one centre's own region pass for the whole.
passages.reading: AI 的读法：两处有脊柱定律。“以我之大私为天下之大公”：一个中心把自身区域当作整体，而中心不是沿依赖导出的（Clearing.center_not_derived），以依赖为界的中心彼此不一致（centers_disagree）。“天下之利尽归于己”的结构：一个取尽所给的形成若持续，旁边不留其他取者（Flow.continuing_excludes、TakesAll），取尽者与其他取者并存时，每个依赖者终结，取尽者自己也在内（Flow.full_taking_ends）。“天下为主，君为客”与此相反：部分在整体之中，不把整体当作自己的。此条只承接结构；经文的“古者”是叙述，不是推导。
passages.reading_en: Passing one's own region off as the whole matches the spine's centres not derived along dependence, and the one who takes all leaves no other taker and, alongside another, ends every dependent including itself; 天下为主 reverses this, though its 'in antiquity' is narrative.

passages.work: 董仲舒《春秋繁露·深察名号》
fragments: 天生民性有善質而未能善，於是為之立王以善之，此天意也。
王承天意以成民之性為任者也
